offensive.component: Spin / Non Spin Starting Position / Set Up

priorities: Release speed on the spin shot (Stage 4)
Target: average release speed of 55 km/h on video by the Nov review
Target: 7/10 on the corner-target drill, tracked weekly in practice
Target: reaction time under 0.45 s on the defensive reaction drill
plan.reflection:
Improved: my ready position and ball control are much more consistent, and I've hit every practice since August. My non-spin release is quicker.

Needs improvement: I lose speed at Stage 4 of the spin shot when I'm tired late in practice, and my first step on cross-court balls is still a beat late.
plan.dashboardReflection: Yes. I'm averaging over 11 hours a week with steady load (ACWR around 1.0), so I can add shooting volume safely. Three of my weights sessions each week support release speed, and the Thursday interval session matches the repeated efforts I need on defence. My sleep score dips on double days — I'll protect bedtime on Mondays and Wednesdays.
plan.nextAction: Film 20 spin shots after Wednesday practice each week and log release speed; share the clip with coach before Friday's session.
plan.coachFeedback: Great consistency this block — training volume and attendance are exactly where they need to be. Keep the extra shooting volume to 20 reps so quality stays high, and bring the same intent to the reaction drill as you do to shooting.
